description_en: Creates a binding relationship between a dataset and an Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket. This allows for the automatic synchronization of incremental and full data and indexing
description_zh: 创建数据集（Dataset）和对象存储（OSS）Bucket的绑定关系，自动同步全量和增量文件并为其索引
kebab_example: aliyun imm create-binding --project-name test-project --dataset-name test-dataset --uri oss://test-bucket --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateBinding

parameters.description_en: The name of the project. You can obtain the name of the project from the response of the [CreateProject](~~478153~~) operation.
parameters.description_zh: 项目名称，获取方式请参见[创建项目](~~478153~~)。
parameters.help_en: The name of the project. You can obtain the name of the project from the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478153.html operation
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.description_en: The name of the dataset. You can obtain the name of the dataset from the response of the [CreateDataset](~~478160~~) operation.
parameters.description_zh: 数据集名称，获取方式请参见[创建数据集](~~478160~~)。
parameters.help_en: The name of the dataset. You can obtain the name of the dataset from the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478160.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 数据集名称，获取方式请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478160.html
parameters.name: dataset_name

parameters.description_en:
The URI of the OSS bucket to which you bind the dataset.

Specify the value in the oss\://${Bucket} format. `${Bucket}` specifies the name of the OSS bucket that resides in the same region as the current project.
parameters.description_zh:
数据集绑定的对象存储（OSS） Bucket URI。

对象存储（OSS） Bucket URI 的格式为oss://${Bucket}，其中`${Bucket}`为和当前项目处于同一地域的 OSS Bucket 名称。
